title.zh: 《绝地求生》厂商开源30B模型：修Bug接近Meta，底层用上Kimi和DeepSeek技术
title.en: 《绝地求生》厂商开源30B模型：修Bug接近Meta，底层用上Kimi和DeepSeek技术

current_state.zh: KRAFTON released the open-weights Raon-1 mini preview, a 28.8B-parameter MoE model with 4.3B active parameters, 256K context, Apache 2.0 licensing, and benchmark results near Meta's model on code repair while using attention and training techniques derived from Kimi and DeepSeek.
